message:
feat(desktop): spelling issues offer an enharmonic-toggle action (#176) (#177)

The review bar's action slot only handled suggestVoicesTexture, so a

pitch_spelling_ambiguous issue showed pitch +/- buttons (which change

sounding pitch — the wrong fix for a spelling problem) and no direct

action. Spelling issues now surface the same enharmonic toggle the E

key applies, resolving the ambiguity in place.

Closes #176
